# Cosmic Duality, six-answer hash — 2026-11-27

Nothing opened. 32 decrypts, 0 valid PKCS#7 blocks, 0 sentence-like plaintexts. The Half key was not checked.

The ciphertext is `data/locked_cosmic_duality.bin`, 1344 bytes, salt `2d3f6fe06dc950e6`, SHA-256 `b18950551a4dd0cb8a9378f0906ba18c03a15f0ee83eb98c6bc90165c5f79805`. The six answers were read back off `data/salphaseion_compact_1075.txt` in page order, and the three `z` separators on that page are at the recorded boundaries. The phase 3.2 envelope still opens with the lowercase hex of SHA-256 and EVP-SHA256, and that same code produced these rows.

Inner is the six answers joined by the separator. `yinyang` is appended to that string with no extra separator. `rounds=1` hashes the inner once. `rounds=2` is SHA-256(SHA-256(inner)). `hex-lower` is the 64-character hex passphrase. `raw` is the 32-byte digest. `hex-upper` is the uppercase-hex backstop. Printable ASCII is the share of bytes in 0x20–0x7E across the raw 1328-byte decrypt. The preview is the first 200 bytes, hex because none of them were text.

Random bytes land near 95/256 = 0.371. These ratios run from 0.3449 to 0.3968.
